question: In a certain code language, ‘RELATIONS' is written as 'TSRONLIEA', and 'NUMBER' is written as 'URNMEB'. How will 'SPECULATION' be written in that language?
solution:
__
 
• **Code:**__ letters written in reverse alphabetical order
 
• RELATIONS 

Alphabetical order: A S > R > O > N > L > I > E > A

Thus, code is TSRONLIEA

 
• NUMBER

​Alphabetical order: B R > N > M > E > B

 
• Similarly, SPECULATION

Alphabetical order: A T > S > P > O > N > L > I > E > C > A

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
